purpose: Upstreams that no longer serve their pinned files. upstream_pins.json is left byte-identical: the pins stay the identity. pin_upstream.py --verify records a 404 on a file of a source listed here instead of failing, only while every record named is present with its pinned sha256. Bytes that are fetched again must still match the pins exactly; any other error still fails; nothing is cached for a vanished file, so --materialize refuses it. The only lawful bytes are a recovered copy verified against the pins (H1-MATERIALISATION-AMENDMENT-1). No repin, no reconstruction, no substitution.
